course_description:
The course introduces students to research methods in econometrics and applied economics. It focuses on preparing the students to read theoretical research papers in econometrics by exposing them to the methodology of theoretical econometrics. It also exposes the students to the methodological implications of theoretical econometrics with respect to applied economics.

This course is designed for students with a strong background in both Econometrics and Statistics. The main objective is to further the understanding of both theoretical aspects of econometrics and advanced econometric techniques by building upon the knowledge gained in previous courses.

The assessments for the course will involve students using the econometric foundations and techniques they learn in class.ﾠ

learning_outcomes.description: Understand and analyse how an econometric result is stated and proved in an econometric research paper.
Assess how to apply an econometric result to data.
Evaluate how to interpret econometric results in view of applied economics.
Formulate how to be critical and deconstruct existing methodologies.
